$comment: DETERMINISTIC evaluation of the harness (scripts/harness-eval.mjs, a gate signal), grouped by WHEN the piece acts: `guides` before the agent decides, `rules` before a tool runs, `signals` after acting. Every label says what a GOOD harness should do, not what it does today. The shape is cases.schema.json; `lang` marks the language of a case's human content (es | en; absent = neutral). Keys and enum values are English; prompts, messages and file contents are in the case's language. The Spanish strings in `contains` (`**bugfix**`) and in `reasonCriteria.nextStep` are compared against the harness output, which speaks Spanish.

guides.$comment: Before the agent decides. `intent`: is the prompt a question to answer or an action to take (the ask-first marker). `prompt`: what the prompt hooks put in front of the agent. Plus `reasonCriteria`, applied to every reason the `rules` run produced.

reasonCriteria.$comment: A block that says what happened but not what to do is retried as is. Spanish on purpose: it is matched against the harness messages. Word edges are `(?<!\p{L})…(?!\p{L})` and not `\b`: in JavaScript `\b` is ASCII, so `contestá\b` never matches.
